# Marquee

[← Floating action button](floating_action_button.md) · [All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [Section list →](section_list.md)

<img src="../gifs/marquee.gif" width="300" alt="Marquee">

Endless tickers moving at their own speeds, rows alternating direction.

Reanimated docs: [examples/marquee](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/examples/marquee)

## What to look at

- `useFrameCallback` advances one shared offset by `childWidth / duration` per millisecond, wrapping at one child width.
- The content is measured once, then cloned enough times to cover the screen. Every clone reads the same offset, so the loop has no seam.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import '../components/marquee.dart';

/// examples/marquee: endless tickers moving at their own speeds, rows
/// alternating direction, driven by useFrameCallback.
class MarqueeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MarqueeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<MarqueeScreen> createState() => _MarqueeScreenState();
}

class _MarqueeScreenState extends State<MarqueeScreen> {
  bool reverse = false;

  static const words = [
    ('Reanimated', Palette.purple),
    ('DartNative', Palette.blue),
    ('60 / 120 fps', Palette.pink),
    ('Shared values', Palette.yellow),
    ('Springs', Color(0xFF7FD1FA)),
  ];

  Widget _chips(int shift) => Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++)
            Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: words[(i + shift) % words.length].$2,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
              ),
              child: Text(words[(i + shift) % words.length].$1,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: Palette.navy)),
            ),
        ],
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DemoPage(
        title: 'Marquee',
        docs: 'examples/marquee',
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Marquee(reverse: reverse, duration: const Duration(seconds: 6), child: _chips(0)),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Marquee(reverse: !reverse, duration: const Duration(seconds: 9), child: _chips(2)),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Marquee(reverse: reverse, duration: const Duration(seconds: 4), child: _chips(4)),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            Marquee(
              reverse: reverse,
              duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
              child: const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: 32),
                child: Text('BREAKING · animations run on the frame clock ·',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 28, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: Palette.navy)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 32),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () => setState(() => reverse = !reverse),
              child: const Text('Reverse'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/marquee.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// The Reanimated site's `Marquee`: [child] is measured, cloned enough
/// times to cover the width plus two, and every clone is shifted by one
/// offset that a frame callback advances by `childWidth / duration` per
/// millisecond, wrapping at one child width so the loop never shows a seam.
class Marquee extends StatefulWidget {
  const Marquee({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.duration = const Duration(seconds: 2),
    this.reverse = false,
  });

  final Widget child;

  /// Time for the content to move by one copy of [child].
  final Duration duration;
  final bool reverse;

  @override
  State<Marquee> createState() => _MarqueeState();
}

class _MarqueeState extends State<Marquee> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  double childrenWidth = 0;
  double childrenHeight = 0;

  late final offset = useSharedValue(0.0);
  late final coeff = useSharedValue(widget.reverse ? 1.0 : -1.0);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    useFrameCallback((i) {
      if (childrenWidth <= 0) return;
      final dtMs = (i.timeSincePreviousFrame?.inMicroseconds ?? 1000) / 1000;
      final ms = widget.duration.inMicroseconds / 1000;
      offset.value = (offset.value + coeff.value * dtMs * childrenWidth / ms) % childrenWidth;
    });
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(Marquee oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    coeff.value = widget.reverse ? 1.0 : -1.0;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final parentWidth = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width;
    // First build: draw one copy invisibly, only to measure its width.
    if (childrenWidth == 0) {
      return Opacity(
        opacity: 0,
        child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          AnimatedView(
            onLayout: (size) => setState(() {
              childrenWidth = size.width;
              childrenHeight = size.height;
            }),
            child: widget.child,
          ),
        ]),
      );
    }
    final count = (parentWidth / childrenWidth).round() + 2;
    return SizedBox(
      height: childrenHeight,
      child: ClipRect(
        child: Stack(
          clipBehavior: Clip.hardEdge,
          children: [
            for (var index = 0; index < count; index++)
              Positioned(
                left: (index - 1) * childrenWidth,
                top: 0,
                child: _TranslatedElement(offset: offset, child: widget.child),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// One clone, shifted by the shared offset.
class _TranslatedElement extends StatefulWidget {
  const _TranslatedElement({required this.offset, required this.child});
  final SharedValue<double> offset;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<_TranslatedElement> createState() => _TranslatedElementState();
}

class _TranslatedElementState extends State<_TranslatedElement> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final animatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(translateX: widget.offset.value));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedView(style: animatedStyle, child: widget.child);
}
```
